description: Renames a label or changes its colour. A new name applies to every thread that carries the label. Returns the label.

color.description: A new colour from the same palette of 12. Left out, the colour stays as it is; a request must carry `name`, `color` or both.

name.description: Renaming a label renames it on every thread that carries it.

name: mails_labels_update
title: Update a label
